text:
I got a call from the pipeline patrol guy at 11:45 on March 3. He said there was a fire near our
facility at Fox Creek, Alberta, that was spotted at 10:30 today. Apparently, some construction
activity was happening nearby and people had to evacuate or shelter in place because of
fumes or smoke. The patrol guy didn't have any more info on the construction, just that it
was going on near our site. He confirmed that the fire was at our facility or on our
equipment, and that it didn't involve a pipeline leak - - no product was released. I'm still trying
to get more details.
- J. Smith, On-Call Patrol Contractor
